description: This Python source file implements classes and functions for managing npm registry entries, including handling package manifests, cache operations, and URI construction relevant to npm packages.

classes.name: PackageJson
classes.description: Represents an npm package specification, providing access to package metadata and manifest formatting.

classes.name: Manifest
classes.description: Context manager class for handling package manifest file with locking mechanism.

classes.name: ManifestImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing loading and saving of manifest data.

classes.name: NpmCache
classes.description: Handles npm cache directory operations and cache-related commands.

classes.name: NpmRegistry
classes.description: Manages interactions with the npm registry, including adding packages and constructing URIs.
